name: kdd-codex
description: Use project decisions to prepare software changes and check the result with agreed tests.

interface.longDescription: Use the decisions and rules saved alongside your code to prepare a task, agree on tests, and keep results the team can review. For a payment change, Codex can read the country limits and recipient rules, use them to prepare the task and its tests, and report the results. This is a skill-only plugin and does not send data or connect to external services.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this task using KDD contracts and verification.
Create a KDD contract and a frozen regression test for this change.
Audit this implementation against its KDD evidence.
